bank.title: Question Bank
bank.subtitle: Every quiz and exam question across the 6th Scientific curriculum, with review status and live accuracy.
bank.bulkConfirmBody: Only questions eligible for this step will change. Every change is recorded in the audit log.

editor.newSubtitle: Write the stem in both languages, add options and an explanation, then submit it for academic review.
editor.notFoundHint: It may have been deleted or the link is incorrect.
editor.questionCardHint: Use $…$ for LaTeX, **bold** and *italic* for emphasis.
editor.imageHint: Optional diagram shown under the question (PNG, JPG or SVG).
editor.optionsHint: Mark exactly one option as correct. Students see options in randomized order.
editor.tfHint: Choose whether the statement is true or false.
editor.fillBlankHint: Add every spelling you will accept. Matching ignores letter case.
editor.explanationHint: Shown to students after they answer. Walk through the key step.
editor.awaitingReview: Waiting for an Academic Supervisor to review.
editor.tagsHint: Press Enter or comma to add a tag.
editor.studentPreviewHint: Exactly what students see in the app. Try answering it.
editor.lockedPublished: Published questions can only be edited by an Academic Supervisor.
editor.publishBody: It will become available to quizzes and exam blueprints immediately.
editor.archiveBody: It will be removed from future quizzes. Past attempts keep their history.

preview.empty: Start typing the question to see the preview…

validation.bodyShort: The question text is too short
validation.acceptedRequired: Add at least one accepted answer
validation.emptyOption: Every option needs English and Arabic text
validation.oneCorrect: Mark exactly one option as correct
validation.duplicateOption: Two options have the same text

review.title: Review Queue
review.subtitle: Approve or return questions submitted by content teachers. Returned questions go back to draft with your comment.
review.noPermission: Only Academic Supervisors can approve or reject questions. You can still read the queue.
review.emptyHint: No questions are waiting for review in this subject.
review.allDoneHint: New submissions will appear here automatically.
review.commentHint: Required when returning a question; optional when approving.
review.commentPlaceholder: e.g. Option C is ambiguous — rephrase the distractor.
review.commentRequired: Add a comment explaining what needs to change
review.rejectBody: The question goes back to draft. Your comment is shown to the author.
review.shortcuts: J / K move · A approve · R write a comment

import.title: Bulk Import
import.subtitle: Upload many questions at once from the EDUWAY template. Rows are validated before anything is saved.
import.uploadHint: CSV (UTF-8) or Excel files exported from the template.
import.formats: CSV or XLSX · up to 10 MB
import.rule1: subject uses the key: math, physics, chemistry, biology or english.
import.rule2: unit and topic are their order numbers inside the subject (1, 2, 3…).
import.rule3: type is mcq, true_false or fill_blank; difficulty is easy, medium or hard.
import.rule4: correct is the option letter (A–D). Every option needs English and Arabic text.
import.rule5: Imported questions are saved as drafts and must pass review before publishing.
import.xlsxMock: Excel parsing is simulated in this demo — showing the sheet's sample rows.
import.emptyFile: The file has no data rows
import.errUnit: Unit {{value}} does not exist in this subject
import.errTopic: Topic {{value}} does not exist in this unit
import.errBody: Question text is missing or too short
import.errCorrect: Correct answer “{{value}}” does not match an option
import.errExplanation: Explanation is required in both languages
import.doneHint: Questions from {{file}} were added as drafts and logged in the audit trail.
